name: Design System
description: Populated DESIGN.md contract, CSS custom property tokens, Tailwind config extension, base component stubs

validation.message: Must be a 3- or 6-digit hex color, e.g. #6366f1

questions.prompt: Dark mode strategy? (shipped as class-toggle; DESIGN.md documents switching to media-query/none)
UI component base to grow the stubs toward? (stubs are framework-agnostic; install the chosen library yourself)

checklist: Install peer deps: npm install clsx tailwind-merge (plus tailwindcss + your component_base library, e.g. shadcn-ui/radix/headlessui)
Review DESIGN.md — it is now the design contract; AI agents and reviewers treat it as the source of truth
Import src/styles/globals.css once at the app root (e.g. app/layout.tsx)
Set --color-brand-primary (and the neutrals) in src/styles/tokens.css; the hover shade derives from primary automatically
Verify token classes resolve: run the app and check e.g. text-brand-primary / bg-surface in DevTools
Storybook (if enabled): npm install -D @storybook/nextjs @storybook/addon-essentials, then npx storybook dev -p 6006
